== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ケッセル</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-126o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配していれば、フォース消耗に＋１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配していれば、「ケッセル・ラン」を阻止（キャンセル）できる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Kessel.

'''Light Side:''' If you control here, add 1 to the Force drain.

'''Dark Side:''' If you control here, you may stop (cancel) Kessel Run.

== Statistics ==
* '''Uniqueness:''' Unique (one marker)
* '''Subtype:''' System (planet)
* '''Light Force icons:''' 1
* '''Dark Force icons:''' 2
* '''Parsec:''' 8<ref name="jp-face" />
